correctness.rationale: For Bf=(f-f(0))/z and F=z(I-t)+c with inner I(0)=r=sqrt(phi/2), phi=(1+sqrt5)/2, t=(2phi)^(-1/2), directly reconstruct ||B^2F||_4^4=1-r^4 and ||F||_4^4=D+|c|^4+4q|c|^2+4q Re(conj(c)conj(I'(0))) using Fourier coefficients, where q=t^2,D=(1-r^4)/phi. The only negative-frequency term in z(I-t)|I-t|^2 is q conj(I'(0)). Strict convexity of x^4+4qx^2-4q|I'(0)|x gives unique cubic minimizer; Schwarz-Pick bound |I'(0)|<=1-r^2 is sharp exactly for degree-one Blaschke automorphisms. Independent direct bisection gave delta=0.0941415110017, fourth-power quotient 1.7075217924014 and norm 1.1431193171062>phi^(1/4)=1.1278384855617. This proves the sharp restricted-family quotient and a strict lower bound on global ||B^2||, NOT the global exact norm. Boundary c=0 and singular inner functions covered by bounded boundary expansions.
